description: This file defines a set of API command routes for accessing equity estimates, including price targets, analyst estimates, consensus data, analyst search, and forward financial estimates (sales, EBITDA, EPS, PE). It uses decorators to define commands and relies on external modules for querying data and handling command context.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class for managing API route definitions and command registration.

classes.description: A class representing example API requests used for documentation or testing.
